engineering_interpretation: This table defines the logic for controlling the brake light, specifying how the BrkLightDrvMdl activates the brake light by sending BrakeLightState=1 and how it exits this state upon receiving a command from BrkLightCtrlMdl indicating BrakeLightState=0. It is primarily used for testing the correct activation and deactivation behavior of the brake light system.
